mentions.name: raymenuz
mentions.description: A hot reloadable menu library for raylib/raygui applications written in Zig, intended as a developer menu for raylib games that lets you add or remove game state fields on screen without recompiling.
mentions.problem: Adding or removing game state fields to and from the screen previously required recompiling; the library enables hot reloading so this can be done without a rebuild.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A hot reloadable menu library for raylib / raygui applications in Zig.

https://github.com/pajanowski/raymenuz

I want to use this for future raylib games as a developer menu.
